Seven pernicious gaps that impact builders of GenAI products and a brief review of the companies working to close them. 

Michael Spencer and Adam JudelsonJul 08, 2024∙ Paid373ShareHey Everyone, 

Recently there’s been a great debate about if BigTech’s investment in Generative AI is warranted. I asked the very talented Adam Judelson about his take on the product space at the intersection of Generative AI. How can builders and entrepreneurs think this through. 

There are so many interesting Generative AI use cases and products. 

Builders are scrambling to build Generative AI tools, including many people who work in product at technology companies.
